newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields fall on Bulgaria 9-, 12 mth floater T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on Bulgaria 9-, 12 mth floater T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell on Bulgaria's Finance Ministry nine-month and 12-month, floating interest T-bills due to a lower discount and a cut in the central bank main interest rate, central bank figures showed on Tuesday.
Yield to maturity on the two issues auctioned on Monday was 53.58 and 70.77 percent, down from 64.27 and 84.78 percent a week earlier.
The average accepted prices for the two issues were 95.5 and 95 percent, up from 94.75 and 94.27 percent for the respective two issues auctioned on May 5.
The issues were offered with no par values or minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Interest on the issues was set equal to the central bank main interest rate and is adjusted every time the rate changes. Interest payments on the issues are due at maturity.
Bids were received for a total of 13.350 billion levs of T-bills but the ministry approved bids for 2.429 billion levs worth of paper.
The main interest rate has been set at 5.2 percent monthly since Monday, down from 6.2 percent monthly a week earlier.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Bids received 5,150 million levs 8,200 million levs
Average price of bids 94.91 pct 94.52 pct
Bids approved 1,000 million levs 1,428.5 million levs
Average yield to maturity 53.58 pct 70.77 pct
